content:
Hey guys, I’ve been playing this game for a bit and I’ve really been enjoying the story. I’m level 44 currently and have been completing the hard modes of the stories alongside the chapters I finish but I’m struggling with the hydra Miryam boss.

My problem with this boss is that it starts off with 4k hp, which is actually hard for my team to kill without mouchette exalting once. 

Then, it goes into second phase where I find I can’t kill the tentacles unless I use a lot of resources(exalts, embryos, posse, bc the only aoe is the passive follow up dmg), and since it seems you’re kind of forced to tank the damage since the boss has 90% dmg reduction with 30k hp, and so you have to survive a 1k hit every turn, which my team can’t do. 

Then after that it becomes 60k hp again(i got to this point, it should be easy to kill bc no reduction, but i had 0 exalts and no posse so i could only wait to die. I cant really stall turns either)

My question is, are there any better teams I can makeI that can survive 1k hits without using death resistance? (And anything else I can fix)

content:
Hello there : )

Caraboo is more potent but wants to be pampered. And even then, you might be stuck with a boon you don't need.

Horla gives a passive boost so she will help you even when you ignore her past the first leap.

Beyond that, Boo is caro and Horla is ultra. Could be worth considering what realm you need.
